observations: Both gables show their own masonry below the upper steel-framed arched window. The street side carries the green 63 sign; the courtyard side retains its own face.
The oblique archivolt view separates the light joints, radial bricks, stepped capitals and red pantiles. From the passage the open gates clear the paving and frame the complete far arch.
Both close roof views now resolve the raised clay covers, narrow valleys, light gable coping and green eaves gutter. The inside view shows the lower iron scrolls and brick lining.
comparison_to_first: Compared all fourteen decoded views to the first geometry images. The roof framing was reduced from 11.4 to 5.64 metres for the individual tile run. The centre passage was checked against separate independently exported meshes and three 2015 street viewpoints.
limits: The model ends at the courtyard face of the gatehouse. The interior passage depth and upper roof detailing were estimated from the exterior views.
